title: Ankhorage Design Rules
summary: Provides reusable design rules and evidence-backed website design recognition.
purpose: Centralize declarative design policy and recognition logic without coupling capture, rendering, or migration tools to duplicated design rules.
responsibilities: Assemble canonical website recognition from observation documents.
Inspect canonical website recognition documents through public capabilities.
boundaries: Does not capture websites or execute browser automation.
Does not render or migrate recognized designs.
Does not own the portable observation document contracts or the generic rules engine.
audience: Recognition, migration, and authoring tools that need canonical design facts.
useCases: Recognize website design from a canonical observation document.
Inspect an existing website recognition document.
Evaluate reusable design rules against supplied facts.

architecture.role: Design-specific policy and recognition provider over portable Contracts and the generic Rules engine.
invariants: Recognition consumes portable observation documents rather than live browser state.
Rule evaluation remains evidence-backed and deterministic.
Capture and rendering stay outside this package.
